# Malachi Chapter 1 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A) | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/MAL_001_page_001.jpg

---

## Consensus Translation

**1:1** The-oracle [massa] of-the-word of-YHWH to-Yisra'el by-the-hand [be-yad] of-Malakhi [Malachi].

**1:2** "I-have-loved-you [ahavti etkhem]," says YHWH; and-you-say [va-amartem], "In-what [ba-mah] have-you-loved-us [ahavtanu]?"

**1:6** "A-son [ben] honors [yekhabbad] [his] father [av], and-a-servant [eved] his-master [adonav]. And-if I [am] a-father [av], where [ayyeh] [is] my-honor [khevodi]? And-if I [am] a-master, where [is] my-fear [mora'i]?" says YHWH of-Hosts to-you, O-priests [ha-kohanim] who-despise [bozei] my-name [shemi].

---
## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Malachi 1 — part of the Book of the Twelve (Minor Prophets).
